mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_manual_adjustment_line (id, adjustment_id, line_no, account_id, entry_side, amount, line_description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{line.id}, #{line.adjustmentId}, #{line.lineNo}, #{line.accountId}, #{line.entrySide}, #{line.amount}, #{line.lineDescription}, #{line.createTime}, #{line.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, adjustment_id, line_no, account_id, entry_side, amount, line_description, create_time, update_time FROM t_manual_adjustment_line WHERE adjustment_id = #{adjustmentId} ORDER BY line_no
